summary: GEO supplies counts for all six registered libraries. The preprint’s marker panel uses H9 controls, its bulk expression figure uses adult GTEx brain regions, and the authors’ bulk DE workbook compares mouse age groups. None provides gene-level effects for the registered human htNSC versus hPSC contrast, so author concordance remains unassessed. The proposal passed validation. No ledger was edited.
openIssues: The preprint mentions a Supporting Data Values XLS. Neither version lists it among its supplements, and the public-source search did not locate it. Whether it contains the six-sample author DESeq2 result remains unknown.
